Title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
Actors: Peter Claffey, Dexter Sol Ansell, Daniel Ings
Plot: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.
Awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 13 nominations total
